title: dentaria angulata
intro: Dentaria angulata, commonly known as Toothwort or Cut-leaved Toothwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, helping to relieve coughs and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dentaria angulata include its ability to reduce inflammation, ease muscle spasms, and promote expectoration, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Dentaria angulata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
